[NTST.1.1] **Mock clock for everything time-related.**
libds exposes a mock clock via `ds_engine_clock_set_mode`,
`ds_engine_clock_set` / `_advance` and `ds_engine_wall_clock_set`. Use it
unconditionally in tests. Live wall-clock time has no
place in a unit test — TTL-driven retracts, cooldown
windows, `dwell` gates, per-emit TTL all become
non-deterministic if the clock advances on its own.
